criterion: User cannot complete primary goal (PHARMACIST bills a prescription)
description: On Pharmacy Billing the PHARMACIST role gets 403 on GET /drugs (wildcard RBAC). This fails loadInitialData's Promise.all, so the Doctor select is blank and Substitute has no drugs. 'Link item' gets 403 on /pharmacy/prescription-queue/inventory-suggestions and shows 'Unable to search inventory'. Every prescription line stays 'No match', and Print Preview is refused with 'Medicine needs review'. The pharmacist cannot produce an invoice.
expected: A pharmacist can link, review and confirm a prescription bill.
actual: Blocked at step 10. The only error shown is the 'needs review' toast.
suggested_fix: Expand wildcard permissions in PermissionsGuard (or seed exact grants). Load the four builder lists independently with Promise.allSettled, and surface any failure.

criterion: Destructive/irreversible action without guard; misleading state
description: Mapped defect #1 confirmed, and it is worse than mapped. 'Paid' and 'Dispense' are enabled as soon as a task is In Review (0/N lines reviewed). One click on Dispense for Vikram Singh's new prescription moved the task straight to DISPENSED (paidAt and dispensedAt set) with no invoice, no payment and no stock deduction (Adapalene stock unchanged at 60). The prescription leaves the active queue as 'Done'.
expected: Dispense is enabled only after a confirmed invoice exists, and payment is recorded or explicitly deferred. The server enforces this.
actual: Unbilled medicine can be marked dispensed in one click. No stock moves and no revenue is recorded.
suggested_fix: Disable Paid/Dispense until the task has a linked confirmed invoice. Validate the transition on the server (require an invoice for PAID/DISPENSED) and add @Roles to the dispense-task controller.

criterion: Primary controls unreachable at default desktop viewport
description: At 1280x800 the Counter's three-column cockpit gives Active Dispense about 270px. The review table (Accept/Sub/Edit/NA) is 550px wider than its column, and its overflow-hidden container is clipped to 2px high, so the Accept buttons cannot be clicked. The status chip and 'Reason or pharmacist note' render one letter per line, and the stat pills overlap ('Exceptions0'). Everything works at 1920x1080.
expected: The Counter works at common laptop widths (1280–1440), for example by stacking Active Dispense full-width below xl.
actual: The pharmacist cannot review lines on a 1280px screen.
suggested_fix: Switch the cockpit grid to 1 column below 1536px (or 2 columns with Active Dispense spanning both), and give the review table overflow-x-auto instead of a hidden min-h-0 flex child.

criterion: Feedback / misleading: payment method chosen but not recorded
description: Mapped defect #7 confirmed. The pharmacist chose Payment Method UPI and confirmed. The invoice was saved CONFIRMED / PENDING, and neither the builder, the preview nor the success toast says payment is outstanding. The printed invoice does not show the payment method. Recording payment needs a different page (Desk → Invoices → Mark as Paid), which is 403 for PHARMACIST.
expected: Checkout records payment for the selected method (or offers 'Mark paid now'), and the invoice shows the payment status and mode.
actual: PHI-2026-001 | CONFIRMED | PENDING | UPI until an admin marked it paid from the list.
suggested_fix: Add a 'Collect now' step to checkout that posts the payment with the same request key, and print the payment mode and status.

description: 'Download PDF' on a confirmed invoice fails (console: html2canvas 'unsupported color function "oklch"'). The toast reads 'PDF failed — Use Print / Save as PDF instead'. After the failure, a leftover div.html2pdf__overlay holding a shrunken clone of the app stays on top and catches every click. The 'Start a new invoice' and 'Reopen' buttons visible in the clone cannot be clicked until a full reload.
expected: The PDF downloads, or a failure cleans up and leaves the page usable.
actual: PDF export is broken for every invoice, and the page is frozen after the attempt.
suggested_fix: Render the PDF from the iframe's plain-CSS print HTML (no Tailwind oklch vars), or use html2canvas-pro. Always remove the html2pdf overlay in a finally block.

criterion: Data integrity: billed prescription silently overwritten
description: After the prescription had been invoiced (PHI-2026-001) and the task was DISPENSED, Dr. Shravya opened the same visit and created a new 1-item prescription. The app updated the existing prescription in place (toast 'Prescription updated — 1 medications'; dialog '0 medications were added'). The 3 billed lines were replaced by Adapalene. The Counter now shows Kavya as '1 medicines · Done', and the invoice no longer matches the prescription.
expected: A billed or dispensed prescription is locked. A new prescription, or an amendment with an audit trail, is created, and the pharmacy queue picks it up as new work.
actual: The billed prescription was mutated with no warning, and the new medicine is never queued for billing.
suggested_fix: Reject updates (409) when the prescription has invoices or dispense tasks, and offer 'Create new prescription'. Fix the dialog count copy.

description: Mapped defect (b) confirmed. The Counter shows 'Pick 30 · 50 available' for Clindamycin 1% Gel 20g (one tube per course) and 'Qty 30' for a sunscreen bottle, because the 30-day once-daily dose count is used as the pick quantity. The prescription saved dosageUnit 'TABLET' for gels and sunscreen, which the Counter shows raw as 'TABLET ONCE_DAILY'. Billing later defaults to 1 tube, so the Counter and Billing disagree.
expected: Pick quantity is in selling units (tubes, strips, bottles), and the dosage form reflects the product.
actual: The Counter tells the pharmacist to pick 30 tubes of gel.
suggested_fix: Reuse the Billing-side 'computed strips/tube' conversion for Pick Assist and the review Qty, and format the enums for display.

description: Counter review rows say 'No inventory match — Needs pharmacist action' while the same row shows IN STOCK and the prescription line already carries an inventoryItemId. After invoice and dispense, the rows show 'Qty 0' and still 'Needs pharmacist action'. The footer still reads 'Ready for billing review', 'Open bill' stays the primary action, and the queue card shows '14m pending' next to 'Done'.
expected: Row and footer state reflect the lifecycle (Dispensed shows a completed summary, with no billing CTA).
actual: Mixed signals about what is left to do.

criterion: Text fit: badges/buttons wrap mid-word at 1280
description: On Pharmacy Billing at 1280, invoice item badges wrap inside their pills ('No mat ch', 'DR UG', 'Prescri ption'). The dispensing queue shows status 'Pe ndi ng' and a vertical 'L o a d' button. In the preview, 'Confirm & Print' wraps over 2 lines.
expected: Badges and buttons stay on one line (whitespace-nowrap), and the item name truncates instead.
suggested_fix: Badge and Button base classes use [overflow-wrap:anywhere] whitespace-normal. Use whitespace-nowrap for short labels.

description: Arriving at Billing from 'Open bill' runs a scrollIntoView that scrolls the document as well as the main pane. The top header bar (search, bell, user) is pushed off-screen, and a blank band about 64px tall appears at the bottom of the viewport.
expected: Only the content pane scrolls, and the shell stays fixed.
actual: The shell is shifted until the user scrolls back up.
suggested_fix: Use scrollIntoView({block:'start'}) on the pane's scroll container (or scrollTo on main), not on the element.

criterion: Detour: doctor cannot reach today's visit from Appointments
description: This belongs to another topic but blocked step 1. For Dr. Shravya, Appointments defaults the Doctor select to 'Praneeta Jain'. The day calendar renders only 09:00–17:00, so today's 18:30–20:00 appointments and their CONT/START buttons never appear. I reached the visit through the Start Visit URL instead.
expected: Defaults to the logged-in doctor, and the grid covers all booked slots.
actual: Two wrong defaults, and the visit is unreachable from the calendar.

description: Failed checkouts (400 'Insufficient stock' in STORY-605) still use up invoice numbers. After PHI-2026-001, the next confirmed invoice was PHI-2026-004, so 002 and 003 are missing. A gapless GST tax-invoice series is usually expected.
expected: The number is allocated only when the checkout commits.
suggested_fix: Allocate the sequence inside the same transaction after the stock checks pass.

description: Mapped #14 confirmed. 'Pharmacy Counter' appears twice on the Counter, 'Pharmacy Billing' twice on Billing and 'Pharmacy Invoices' twice on Invoices. The grand total appears 4 times on the preview screen (header badge, Grand Total, Controls panel and builder footer).
expected: One title per page, with the total shown once prominently.

description: The confirmed invoice omits the payment mode. The amount in words reads 'Nine hundred fifty nine rupees only' for a Grand Total of ₹958.72, with no rounding line shown.
expected: Show 'Paid by: UPI (pending)', and either show a round-off line or give the words to the paise.
actual: The payment mode is missing and the words and figures differ.

description: At 390px the Counter stacks reasonably, but the queue column is wider than the viewport: the card status badges ('Done', 'Queued') are cut off on the right, the grid spills 62px, and 'Change link' wraps.
